+"""Generate the fixed-instance, open-loop Rubik's cube sorting trajectory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session, quat_to_mat
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def generate(s):
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.record_start()
+    p['open_gripper']()
+
+    def move(xyz, quat, speed=0.18):
+        p['move_ee'](xyz, quat, speed=speed, tol=0.0025, settle=4)
+
+    placements = [
+        ('rubiks_cube', [0.56, -0.21]),
+        ('rubiks_cube_2', [0.36, -0.21]),
+        ('rubiks_cube_1', [0.46, -0.21]),
+    ]
+    for name, target in placements:
+        obj = s.objects()[name]
+        center = np.mean(obj['bounds'], axis=0)
+        rotation = quat_to_mat(obj['orientation_wxyz'])
+        # Choose a horizontal cube face normal closest to the default closing axis.
+        axes = [rotation[:, i] for i in range(3) if abs(rotation[2, i]) < 0.2]
+        axis = max(axes, key=lambda a: abs(a[1]))
+        yaw = p['yaw_for_closing_dir'](axis[:2])
+        quat = p['top_down_quat'](yaw)
+        print('PICK', name, 'center', center, 'yaw', yaw, flush=True)
+        move([center[0], center[1], 0.24], quat)
+        move([center[0], center[1], 0.012], quat, speed=0.07)
+        p['close_gripper'](steps=20)
+        print('GRASP', name, s.ee_pose()[0], s.gripper_angle(), flush=True)
+        move([center[0], center[1], 0.24], quat, speed=0.10)
+        lifted = np.mean(s.objects()[name]['bounds'], axis=0)
+        print('LIFT', name, lifted, flush=True)
+        if lifted[2] < 0.15:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'Failed grasp: {name}')
+        move([target[0], target[1], 0.24], quat)
+        move([target[0], target[1], 0.045], quat, speed=0.09)
+        p['open_gripper'](steps=20)
+        print('PLACE', name, s.objects()[name], s.status(), flush=True)
+        if s.status()['success']:
+            break
+        move([target[0], target[1], 0.24], quat, speed=0.12)
+        p['hold'](10)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz')
+    (OUT / 'generation_status.json').write_text(json.dumps(s.status(), indent=2))
+    print('SAVED', len(actions), s.status(), flush=True)
+    return actions
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    session = Session('rubiks_cubes_in_bin', instance='/app/instance.json')
+    generate(session)
+    session.close()
*** End Patch"));
